name: The Centipede
_comment: The centipede at home, by her hollow log behind the old gate (scripts/scary_world.gd). She's only here once Dark Hollow is mended: the last step of her story (Hayden, 11 Nov 2026). First she asks to play her scary game (her boss fight, scripts/centipede_boss.gd; yes or no, recorded). After it: friends for keeps and her tricks (wall crawl, her holes); then a name; then chat.

lines: {player}! You came! You found my home!
The Moon Clock's ticking again. Because of you.
A secret: everyone always runs away from me.
Will you stay when I'm at my very SCARIEST?
It's only a game. You'll only get bumped.
When I'm dizzy, bop my head! Stay till the end to win!
REALLY? Okay. Here I come... RAAAH!
That's okay. Saying no is brave too.
You STAYED! Even when I was my scariest!
Nobody's ever done that. Not once.

choice.text: Of course! That's what friends do.
lines: FRIENDS! (All her legs wiggle.)
For keeps. A centipede promise!

choice.text: I was a bit scared of you, at first. I'm sorry.
lines: Nobody's ever said sorry to me. You were brave anyway.
Friends, then? For keeps!
Here's my trick: walk at a wall and keep going. UP!
Climb onto a ceiling and walk upside down!
{jump} to hop off.
And knock on my holes round the Void!
I'll gulp you up and take you to any hole you've found.
{player}... would you give me a name?

choice.name: Wiggles
lines: WIGGLES! It fits!

choice.name: Shelby
lines: Shelby the centipede. I like it!

choice.name: Sir Legs-a-Lot
lines: SIR Legs-a-Lot? I'm a knight now!
You came back! Most people only come once.
A friend! A real one!

choice.text: I just wanted to see you again.
lines: That's the nicest thing anyone's said to me.

rotate: I've named all 37 mushrooms round my log!
I counted the glow-bugs. Then forgot. Lovely!
Being scary is lonely. Being friends is better.
Scared? It's okay to go home. I'll be here.
